title: Why Being Left Out Hurts (You're Not Being Dramatic)
description:
In a 2003 Science study, people were scanned while playing a virtual ball game in which they were ultimately left out. Activity in one brain region, the anterior cingulate, rose and fell with how distressed they said they felt. One small study of a virtual game: it does not diagnose or advise anyone.

#Shorts #Psychology #Feelings #Relationships #DopamineLoop

Source: Eisenberger, Lieberman & Williams, Science, 2003, doi:10.1126/science.1089134 (abstract on PubMed, PMID 14551436).

If you are struggling, please talk to someone you trust or a qualified professional.
